title: Grassmannian cluster subcategories and positroid varieties
summary: A class of subcategories GP $B$ of the Grassmannian cluster category CM $C_{k, n}$ was constructed by Jensen--King--Su from certain superorders $B$ of $C_{k, n}$, which they showed are in bijection with Grassmannian positroids of type $(k, n)$. We prove that GP $B$ admits a cluster substructure of CM $C_{k, n}$, giving rise to a cluster algebra $A_{clu}$. This naturally raises questions regarding the relationship of $A_{clu}$ to $C[Gr(k, n)]$ and to the coordinate ring of the positroid variety associated to $B$.
